connector.modeled: 50 ohm port at board edge y=-13 (reference plane); connector body not modeled

feed: microstrip_edge_qw: 50 ohm line w = 3.02 mm from y = -13, lambda/4 transformer w = 0.72 mm (Zt = 97.1 ohm) l = 5.22 mm ending on the bottom flat side; no notch, no inset
changed_vs_base.patch_polygon: regular hexagon, vertices at 0, 60 ... 300 deg, circumradius 4.8 mm, centre (0, 3.3) mm, convex, 6 vertices; flat sides toward +-y (4.8 mm long, apothem 4.1569 mm)

feed: inset 2.0 mm with 0.5 mm gaps (notch 4.02 mm in a 5.2 mm flat side)
edge feed through a lambda/4 transformer, no notch
changed_vs_previous.reason: P02_MS1 (EM_SIMULATED) with the same inset gave |S11| ~ -0.7 dB in the channel and an impedance of ~2 ohm at the inset base at f0; a 0.5 mm notch/tab is poorly resolved by a 0.25-0.46 mm mesh; patch moved +3.3 mm in y so the 50 ohm section is long enough for the openEMS MSL port (measurement plane >= 2h from source and from the transformer).

rationale: Revision fabricable y mallable de P03_MS1 (que se conserva sin simular). Cambios: (1) sin muesca ni inset: el hexagono es convexo de 6 vertices y no hay huecos de cobre estrechos; (2) la linea de 50 ohm (3.02 mm, desde y = -13) entra por el borde y se adapta al borde del lado plano inferior con un transformador lambda/4 de 0.72 mm de ancho (Zt = 97.1 ohm) y 5.22 mm de largo, que toca el parche a lo largo de su lado plano (4.8 mm) con 2.04 mm de cobre a cada lado; (3) circunradio 4.8 mm en lugar de 5.2 mm, para que la resonancia quede algo por ENCIMA de f0 una vez aplicados el sesgo observado en P01 y la carga de la ranura central; (4) ranura hexagonal r = 1.1 mm mantenida (lado 1.1 mm, 1.905 mm entre lados planos, 3.20 mm de cobre alrededor); (5) el parche se desplaza a (0, +3.3) mm para que la seccion de 50 ohm mida 6.92 mm y el puerto MSL de openEMS pueda situar su plano de medida a >= 2h de la fuente y del transformador. La orientacion (lados planos a +-y) y el modo excitado (analogo TM11 a lo largo de y, campo maximo entre los lados planos) son los de P03_MS1. R_borde es la incertidumbre dominante: el transformador esta calculado para 188 ohm, punto medio geometrico de la hipotesis 110-320 ohm, y es una calibracion, no una adaptacion establecida. Todo es GEOMETRY_ONLY: no hay S11, ganancia, fase ni retardo de grupo.

inputs.bias_source: P01 FDTD fr 7.47 GHz / 7.9872 GHz (variants/README.md, P01_R1 step 2); the circular-cavity formula is not known to share this bias

line_50ohm.cross_check: Hammerstad 1975 synthesis (w/h>2 formula, t=0) gives w/h = 1.913, i.e. 3.061 mm, equal to the t=0 bisection (3.062 mm); the 35 um copper narrows the line by 0.045 mm
line_50ohm.method: Hammerstad-Jensen, same as P03_MS1 (see variants/P03_MS1.json computation.line_50ohm)

radius_estimate.method: same equal-area circle + TM11 + Garg/Bahl fringing (cited from memory) as P03_MS1

slot_loading_proxy.what: fraction of the TM11 (J1) magnetic energy that lies under the footprint of the central hole (equal-area circle radius 1.000 mm, a_equal_area = 4.365 mm)
slot_loading_proxy.reading: order of magnitude only: a relative downward shift up to ~5 % (half of the energy fraction) is plausible. It is a proxy, NOT a prediction and NOT an EM result.

radius_estimate.edge_feed_loading: No notch; the transformer joint adds a small, unquantified perturbation (fringing is already inside the effective radius).
radius_estimate.estimate_expected_range_GHz: B (biased) minus up to ~5 % slot loading: 7.9-8.3; A (pure) minus the same: 8.4-8.9. Both bracket f0 from above, which is the intent (next excitation covers ~5.5-9.5 GHz).
radius_estimate.choice: r = 4.8 mm. With the observed bias plus slot loading the model sits at about f0 (B 8.29 GHz less up to 5 % -> 7.9 GHz); without bias it sits ~0.4-0.9 GHz above. Preferring 'above' as requested. P03_MS1's r = 5.2 mm gave B = 7.68 GHz, i.e. already below f0 before slot loading.
radius_estimate.uncertainty: fr of the main mode +-5 % or more (hexagon vs circle, bias transfer, slot, board edge 5.5 mm above the patch). Not an EM result.

hex_slot.justification: All void dimensions >= 1.9 mm (>= 7 cells at 0.25-0.3 mm) so it is well resolved; at the TM11 centre E_z ~ 0 and current is max, so it loads inductively (proxy above); enlarging it would lower fr further. Its staircase edges at 60 deg are the only non-grid detail.

R_edge_hypothesis.status: HYPOTHESIS TO CALIBRATE; not a measured or simulated value for this geometry
R_edge_hypothesis.lower_110: P01 probe-derived R_edge 111.7 / 125.7 / 132.7 ohm (em/circuit_fits/*.json, cos^2/sin^2 law), i.e. 110-135 ohm, used with no width scaling. It is an interior-probe extrapolation, not an edge value.
R_edge_hypothesis.upper_320: 135 ohm x (11.42 mm W of P01 / 4.8 mm flat side of P03_MS2) = 321 ohm: edge conductance taken proportional to the radiating width. Assumes only the 4.8 mm flat side radiates; the oblique sides of the hexagon also radiate in a TM11-like mode, which argues for lower values.
R_edge_hypothesis.not_used_cavity_model: Slot-model cavity G1 (Balanis integral, computed here with k0 = 2 pi/lambda0 at f0): R = 1/(2 G1) = 516 ohm for W = 11.42 mm (P01), 2374 ohm for 5.2 mm and 2781 ohm for 4.8 mm. It overestimates the P01 probe-derived value by a factor 3.8-4.7, so its absolute values are not usable; scaling P01 by its G1 ratio (5.4 for 4.8 mm) would give ~730 ohm, which the lambda/4 line cannot match (Zt = 191 ohm, w < 0.1 mm). Literature values for FR4 patch edges are larger than 110-135 ohm (as the orchestrator noted); no literature number is quoted here because none was checked.
R_edge_hypothesis.nominal: geometric mean sqrt(110 x 320) = 187.6 ohm (rounded to 188.5 ohm = Zt^2/50 for the chosen w = 0.72 mm); Zt = 97.1 ohm

effect_on_transformer.feasibility: w >= 0.7 mm needs Zt <= ~98 ohm (R_edge <= ~192 ohm); w >= 0.5 mm needs Zt <= ~110 ohm (R_edge <= ~242 ohm). Above that the matched transformer is thinner than the mesh/fabrication limit; the fixed Zt = 97.1 ohm then leaves a mismatch (table).
effect_on_transformer.mismatch_note: Arithmetic of the assumed load R_edge through an ideal quarter-wave line at f0 (Zin = Zt^2/R). It is NOT the S11 of the design: it ignores the patch reactance, the band, the junction, the slot and losses.

transformer.topology: lambda/4 microstrip section between the 50 ohm line and the bottom flat side; Zt = sqrt(50 x R_edge)

width.method: Hammerstad-Jensen with thickness correction (same formulas as the 50 ohm line), solved for w; w = 0.72 mm gives Zt = 97.09 ohm (target 97.1 ohm)

length.dispersion: Getsinger: eps_eff(f) = eps_r - (eps_r - eps_eff0)/(1 + G (f/fp)^2), G = 0.6 + 0.009 Z0, fp = Z0/(2 mu0 h) = 24.1 GHz at Z0 = 97 ohm. Chosen because FDTD includes dispersion and a narrow line has eps_eff0 = 3.04 (static) rising to 3.23 at f0 (+6 %).
length.uncertainty: static vs dispersive differ by 0.16 mm (3 %) = 2.7 deg of line phase at f0; a lambda/4 transformer is broadband relative to the patch, so this is second order. End effects (50->97 ohm step, line-to-patch junction) are not included.

board_layout.why_offset: With the patch at the origin the 50 ohm section would be 3.6 mm, and add_edge_port (em/patch_openems.py) needs d_src >= h and warns below 2h = 3.2 mm: the 50 ohm section is now 6.92 mm (measurement plane 3.71 mm from the launch plane, 3.21 mm from source and from the transformer). Top margin 5.54 mm = 3.5 h. If the orchestrator prefers a centred patch, em-solver must relax the port constraint instead (feed_shift 0.3 mm).

computation.checks_script: pure-python (segment intersection, point-in-polygon, point-segment distance); reproducible from the coordinates in this JSON

manufacturability.no_gaps_below_mm: no copper-to-copper gap exists (no notch); the only narrow feature is the 0.72 mm transformer
manufacturability.note: Not a verified fabricator capability; 0.72 mm line tolerance of +-0.05 mm moves Zt by about +-5 ohm (estimate from the w(Z) table, not computed separately).

computation.mesh_note_for_em_solver: Transformer 0.72 mm: needs >= 3 cells across (<= 0.24 mm) or mesh lines at its two edges plus one in the middle. Copper joints: line/transformer shared edge at y = -6.076922 and transformer/patch shared edge at y = -0.856922, coordinates bit-identical in feed_polygons_mm and patch_polygon_mm. Slot 1.905 mm flat to flat: >= 6 cells at 0.3 mm.
computation.uncertainty_summary: r from two model estimates (A/B differ 7 %) plus slot loading proxy; R_edge hypothesis spans a factor ~3; hole and junction effects unquantified.
